note: Multiple cohorts and case reports confirm seizures and hypotonia occur recurrently in individuals with LRRC7-related neurodevelopmental disorder.

evidence.text: LRRC7 variants have been documented in cohorts presenting with developmental delay, language impairment, hypotonia, and seizures.

source.title: Further Evidence for LRRC7 Gene Involvement in Neurodevelopmental Disorder: A Novel Variant
source.quote: LRRC7 variants were reported in 33 individuals with developmental delay, language impairment, seizures, … delay, severe cognitive impairment, and hypotonia [5].

evidence.text: Joint genomic analysis of ultra-rare cases links LRRC7 to an emerging disorder characterized by overlapping features including early-onset seizures, developmental delay, and severe hypotonia.

source.title: Joint, multifaceted genomic analysis enables diagnosis of diverse, ultra-rare monogenic presentations
source.quote: had phenotypic overlap of hypotonia and developmental delay… linking LRRC7 to an emerging neurodevelopmental disorder … seizures at a young age, speech delays, severe hypotonia
